description:
Rip a full DVD to MP4 (H.264/HEVC) in 5 mins.

WinX DVD Ripper Platinum backs up DVD collections to hard drive, USB, and other devices with original quality, ripping DVDs to MP4 (H.264/HEVC) and other popular formats with GPU acceleration. It handles 99-title, old, and new DVDs and processes over 3,600,000 DVDs every year.
